response.sql: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS pulse_avg FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry GROUP BY t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus), status_averages AS (SELECT equipstatus, AVG(pulse_avg) AS pulse_avg FROM telescope_averages GROUP BY equipstatus), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(pulse_avg) AS value FROM status_averages), first_kept AS (SELECT sa.pulse_avg, sa.pulse_avg - fm.value AS excess_first FROM status_averages AS sa CROSS JOIN first_mean AS fm WHERE sa.pulse_avg > fm.value), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(pulse_avg) AS value FROM first_kept) SELECT AVG(fk.pulse_avg) AS average_pulse_rate, AVG(fk.excess_first) AS average_excess_first, AVG(fk.pulse_avg - sm.value) AS average_excess_second FROM first_kept AS fk CROSS JOIN second_mean AS sm WHERE fk.pulse_avg > sm.value;

assumptions.assumption: A NULL equipment status forms its own status group; averages ignore NULL pulse rates.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude telescopes with no recorded equipment status.
